entities.name: GraphRAG
entities.description: A method that uses community summaries to generate partial responses and then summarizes them into a final response, showing improvements over conventional RAG.

entities.name: RAG
entities.description: A conventional baseline method for retrieval-augmented generation.

entities.name: global sensemaking questions
entities.description: A class of questions over large datasets that GraphRAG is designed to address.

entities.name: comprehensiveness
entities.description: A measure of the completeness of generated answers.

entities.name: diversity
entities.description: A measure of the variety in generated answers.

relationships.description: GraphRAG leads to substantial improvements over a conventional RAG baseline.
GraphRAG is evaluated on a class of global sensemaking questions.
The performance of GraphRAG is measured by the comprehensiveness of generated answers.
